Big AI News 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Aggregates and deduplicates AI news from multiple Chinese and English tech sources into a single digest.
- Categorizes news into key AI topics for easy browsing.
- Automatically merges duplicate stories and lists all sources/links.
- Adapts output language (Chinese/English) to user queries.
